entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcello Semeraro is an Italian Catholic prelate who has served as prefect of the Dicastery for the Causes of Saints since 2020. He was previously Bishop of Albano and secretary to the College of Cardinals. Pope Francis made him a cardinal in 2020.
